figures.sourceAuthor: Seaq68 (from Pixabay, marked CC0 on Wikimedia Commons)
figures.changes: Local browser relief/parallax renders assembled as an original native RGBA PNG sheet. The published copy replaces the header note, uniformly resizes the whole sheet to 1,600 pixels wide using Lanczos, and uses progressive JPEG quality 85. Scene panels are not cropped, aligned, or retouched; the published pixels are resampled and lossy. AI-made inputs remain labeled. Original PNG hashes are preserved in build.json; originals are not committed in this revision.
